proposals.title: Proposal 5 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding Business Operations in China
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report on the nature and extent to which Merck's corporate operations depend on and are vulnerable to China.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST it.](Board of Directors' Statement in Opposition to Proposal 5 says "recommends a vote AGAINST it"; ERM and disclosure reporting oversight is relevant.)

proposals.title: Proposal 6 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding Access to COVID-19 Products
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on whether public financial support for COVID-19 therapeutic development is considered in decisions affecting product access, such as licensing or pricing.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered this shareholder proposal and recommends a vote AGAINST it.

proposals.title: Proposal 7 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding Indirect Political Spending
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring trade associations and similar groups seeking Merck funds to report their political expenditures, posted on Merck's website.
proposals.evidence: recommends a vote AGAINST it because the Company has significant disclosures already regarding the Company's participation in the political process

proposals.title: Proposal 8 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding Patents and Access
proposals.proponent: Province of Saint Joseph of the Capuchin Order and other co-filers
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a process and report on how extended patent exclusivities' impact on product access is considered when deciding whether to seek secondary and tertiary patents.
proposals.evidence: The Board has considered this shareholder proposal carefully and recommends a vote AGAINST it.

proposals.title: Proposal 9 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding a Congruency Report of Partnerships with Globalist Organizations
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report analyzing whether voluntary partnerships with organizations such as WEF, CFR and Business Roundtable are congruent with fiduciary duties to shareholders.
proposals.evidence: The Board has considered this shareholder proposal carefully and recommends a vote AGAINST it.

proposals.title: Proposal 10 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding an Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring separate Chairman and CEO roles, with the Chairman whenever possible an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered the shareholder proposal and, for the reasons described below, believes adopting it is not in the best interests of Merck's shareholders.
